claim: Lock release is executed via an atomic Lua script that compares the stored lock token against the caller token before deleting, preventing slow workers from releasing locks acquired by successor workers.
mechanism: Atomic Lua Token-Fenced Job Lock Removal
applicabilityConditions: Requires Redis server with Lua scripting support.
localContext: In BullMQ, workers maintain an active lock in Redis. If a worker stalls beyond its lock TTL and a second worker picks up the job, the stalled worker waking up must not delete the lock now held by the second worker. An atomic Lua CAS script enforces token ownership check.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: if redis.call('get', KEYS[1]) == ARGV[1] then return redis.call('del', KEYS[1]) else return 0 end

claim: Delayed and scheduled jobs are indexed in Redis Sorted Sets (ZSET) scored by execution timestamp, where workers poll and promote due jobs atomically into active queues.
mechanism: Redis Sorted Set Delayed Timestamp Scheduling
applicabilityConditions: Requires Redis sorted sets with millisecond score precision.
localContext: BullMQ implements delayed tasks using Redis ZSETs where the score is the epoch millisecond at which the job becomes eligible for processing. Lua scripts atomically move due jobs from the delay ZSET to the wait list.

testProvenance.testName: test delayed job execution after timestamp

claim: Execution retry attempts and worker stall loss incidents are incremented on separate dedicated counters (attemptsMade vs stalledCounter) in prepareJobForProcessing.lua, ensuring process crash recovery does not mask business execution limits.
mechanism: Separate Attempt and Worker-Loss Counters in Redis Hash
applicabilityConditions: Requires Redis hash storage for job metadata with atomic field incrementing.
localContext: BullMQ tracks both how many times a job was picked up by a worker (attemptsMade) and how many times it was detected as stalled after an ungraceful crash (stalledCounter), preventing a crashing node from silently burning normal retry budgets.

testProvenance.testName: test separate attempt vs stalled counters

claim: When a task repeatedly triggers worker crashes or stalls beyond maxStalledCount, moveStalledJobsToWait immediately moves the job to the failed state, isolating poison payloads from infinite recovery loops.
mechanism: Stalled Job Max-Count Quarantine DLQ Isolation
applicabilityConditions: Requires Redis set and hash inspection during periodic stalled job check cycles.
localContext: BullMQ's stalled check cycle marks jobs that have exceeded maxStalledCount (default 1) and moves them directly to the failed queue with an Error('job stalled more than maxStalledCount'), stopping repeated worker crash loops.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: if stalledCount >= maxStalledCount then moveToFailed(jobKey) end

testProvenance.testName: test move stalled job to failed when maxStalledCount exceeded
